_comment: The /docs/ hub: one row per document, written into docs/index.html by tools/docs.js. `status` is `available` or `planned` and is shown in words on the page. An `available` entry must have a `link`; a `planned` one must not, so nothing planned can look like a working document. `more` is optional: the page that owns the detail, so a claim is said once (AGENTS.md rule 2).

docs.title: Origin and plan
docs.line: Why Living Brain exists, what it is planned to be, and what is not built yet.

docs.title: Import your ChatGPT history
docs.line: Export your ChatGPT history from ChatGPT today. The import step is planned.

docs.title: Self-host
docs.line: Run the brain on your own machines and your own Cloudflare account. Planned. Nothing runs yet.

docs.title: CLI
docs.line: One Rust binary for terminals and scripts. Planned. The binary does not exist yet.

docs.title: MCP for coding harnesses
docs.line: Connect a coding harness to the brain over MCP. Planned. The server does not exist yet.

docs.title: API and SDKs
docs.line: An open REST API with webhooks, and SDKs for TypeScript, Python and Rust. Planned. Nothing is published yet.
